package.name: san_follower_tier
package.description: SAN v1.5 — Follower Tier FSM per SDD-SWARM §6.2 (5-Tier). 6-state FSM (T0/T1/T1.5/T2/T3/T4) determining follower tracking behaviour from prediction quality, comm state, and δ. Publishes TierStatusChange per IDS §4.5. KPP-2 (≤ 300ms) measurable via T0→T1.5 transition timing.
